title: Interrabang
writer: Luciano Lucignani, Giorgio Mariuzzo, Edgar Mills
actors: Haydée Politoff, Corrado Pani, Beba Loncar
plot: A photographer is sailing with his wife, her sister and his nympho-maniacal model. He leaves the three women alone to get fuel for his boat. A mysterious man shows up, who might be an escaped murderer the police are searching for....
